newsitem.title: UK: UK money, repo markets quiet ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: UK money, repo markets quiet ahead of weekend.

text.p: The UK money market had a fairly quiet day as a large 1.2 billion stg liquidity shortage was broadly covered by the Bank of England.
* Overnight cash spent most of the day between 6.0 and 6-1/4 percent
* No truly special gilts but some interest in next week's auction stocks, the 7.25 percent gilts due 2007 and the 7.0s of 2002.
* GC rates broadly in line with cash rates, with one-week at 6.05 5.95 and one month at 5.98 92.

* The Bank of England said it would offer 400 million stg at next week's tender of 91-day T-bills, twice the level of recent months. "That tends to mean they anticipate slightly easier money conditions," one trader said.
